name: CI

# Continuous integration: build & test on every push/PR to main.
# Produces UNSIGNED MSIX artifacts for review. Signing only happens in
# release.yml (on version tags) to conserve the Trusted Signing quota and to
# keep signing secrets away from forked PR builds.
#
# All actual work lives in the reusable _build.yml (shared with release.yml,
# so the two can never drift apart): tests first, then MSIX packaging only
# if they pass.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build & test
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_build.yml
